# rustinion_alert_routing (Resource)

Manages where the organization's compliance findings go by severity, the ntfy priority of each push, and when digests go out. Critical findings go out at once to the destinations that take them; warnings and info wait for the digest at digest_hour in digest_timezone. Push destinations (the digest webhook, e.g. ntfy, and PagerDuty) take critical findings only by default, so a digest never pages. One per organization; destroying it puts the defaults back. The webhook URL itself is set on the tenant page.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alert_digest_cadence` (String) every_sweep (as soon as flagged), daily or weekly (Mondays). Default every_sweep.
- `digest_hour` (Number) Hour of the day (0-23, in digest_timezone) daily and weekly digests go out. Default 9.
- `digest_timezone` (String) IANA time zone of digest_hour, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Default UTC.
- `email_severities` (Set of String) Severities sent by email. Default all three.
- `extra_recipients` (List of String) More email addresses (a distribution list works). Default none.
- `notify_all_admins` (Boolean) Email every admin of the organization (besides extra_recipients). Default true.
- `notify_email` (Boolean) Send email at all. Default true.
- `ntfy_priority_critical` (String) ntfy priority of a critical finding. Default urgent.
- `ntfy_priority_digest` (String) ntfy priority of a scheduled digest. Default min (silent).
- `ntfy_priority_info` (String) ntfy priority of an info finding. Default min (silent).
- `ntfy_priority_warning` (String) ntfy priority of a warning sent on its own. Default low (silent).
- `pagerduty_severities` (Set of String) Severities that trigger PagerDuty. Default critical only.
- `summary_digest_cadence` (String) The summary email of finding types set to "summary email only": daily or weekly. Default weekly.
- `webhook_severities` (Set of String) Severities sent to the digest webhook (Slack-compatible or ntfy). Default critical only.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `alert-routing`.
